title: Large Charge Jets in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM Energy Correlators
summary: We compute the energy-energy correlator in a state created by a heavy canonical operator of scaling dimension $Δ_H$ in $\mathcal{N}=4$ $SU(N)$ SYM, at fixed $N$ and arbitrary values of the large charge 't Hooft coupling $λ\sim Δ_H g_{\rm YM}^2$. The state created by the canonical operator triggers spontaneous breaking of conformal symmetry and the Higgs mechanism, with squared W-boson masses proportional to $λ$.
